rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for moving technology, equipment, services, or a class to a newer or better level, especially when a version change is involved.

example.english: I want to upgrade my computer to the latest system, so it will start up much faster.
example.traditional: 我想將部電腦升級到最新系統，開機會快好多。
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 zoeng1 bou6 din6 nou5 sing1 kap1 dou3 zeoi3 san1 hai6 tung2 hoi1 gei1 wui5 faai3 hou2 do1

rows.note: Use this for an improved version or replacement product, especially software, devices, or other technology.

example.english: I got the upgrade version of the phone, and the photos are much clearer.
example.traditional: 我換咗部手機嘅升級版，影相清好多。
example.jyutping: ngo5 wun6 zo2 bou6 sau2 gei1 ge3 sing1 kap1 baan2 jing2 soeng2 cing1 hou2 do1

rows.note: Use this for a general improvement in a situation, condition, or result rather than for an upgraded product.

example.english: After changing the approach, the results showed a noticeable upgrade.
example.traditional: 改咗個做法之後，成績有明顯改善。
example.jyutping: goi2 zo2 go3 zou6 faat3 zi1 hau6 sing4 zik1 jau5 ming4 hin2 goi2 sin6

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on improving quality, performance, or living standards rather than replacing the item with a newer version.

example.english: The hotel wants to upgrade its service quality, so it arranged training for all its staff.
example.traditional: 間酒店想提升服務質素，所以安排晒啲員工受訓。
example.jyutping: gaan1 zau2 dim3 soeng2 tai4 sing1 fuk6 mou6 zat1 sou3 so2 ji5 on1 paai4 saai3 di1 jyun4 gung1 sau6 fan3

rows.traditional: 將 A 換成好啲嘅 B
rows.jyutping: zoeng1 A wun6 sing4 hou2 di1 ge3 B
rows.note: Use this when the key point is explicitly replacing A with a better B, rather than simply raising its level or version.

example.english: We decided to upgrade the old television to a better smart TV, so we would not need repairs so often.
example.traditional: 我哋將舊電視換成好啲嘅智能電視，唔使再成日維修。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zoeng1 gau6 din6 si6 wun6 sing4 hou2 di1 ge3 zi3 nang4 din6 si6 m4 sai2 zoi3 sing4 jat6 wai4 sau1
